violations.text: Various food was observed held between 45-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the 2-door lowboy. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food in unit was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in unit until unit is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026
Establishment is lacking a three-compartment sink. A three-compartment sink is required for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing food-contact equipment and utensils. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026
